issue_request: FHIR-54320 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 asking to remove the modifier marker from Device.name.display because the boolean only identifies the preferred display name and does not modify the semantic meaning of the name.
initial_application: There was no separate source change uniquely for FHIR-54320. The Jira resolution and comment state that the modifier is being removed as part of FHIR-55372, and f22405098ca56696b5de3ef2359acb6e4333a661 had already removed the Device.name.display modifier lines for FHIR-55372.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml has Device.name.display without isModifier or isModifierReason. FHIR-55372 is the earlier Applied/Persuasive implementation vehicle. FHIR-54963 remains Waiting for Input about 5Ws mapping display and is not a final modifier decision. A stale checked-in SVG tooltip still mentions modifier semantics, but it is a generated-looking artifact and the authoritative XML source is correct.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current specification source already satisfies FHIR-54320 through the FHIR-55372 application.
